jobs.description:
Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is a subsidiary of Safran Aircraft Engines, based at Brussels Airport (Zaventem & Steenokkerzeel, Belgium), specialized in the inspection, maintenance and repair (MRO) of the advanced LEAP jet engines that power the latest generation of the Airbus A320NEO & Boeing B737MAX narrow body families. The company is a key player in the integrated CFM international MRO network. With more than 75 years of experience, and up to 20 international Part 145 certifications (EASA/ FAA/ CAAC/ …), Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is recognized as a worldwide center of expertise in the air transport industry. More than a 100 airlines, lessors, private aircraft operators and MRO partners have entrusted their engines to our company. We employ over 600 highly skilled, passionate and enthusiastic employees.

To strengthen our Accounts Team we are looking for a Customer Operations Manager (Jet Engines):The Customer Operations Manager leads the Shop Visit Managers and administrators within the Accounts team. This team consolidates the factory-wide operational status and plays a key role in ensuring transparent communication, coordination, and escalation management to support the efficient execution of engine shop visits.The Customer Operations Manager and his/her team are also responsible for the relationship, communication, and shop visit coordination with our external customers (airlines). He/she acts as the main point of contact for new customer onboarding, the management of complaints and disputes, and any other customer-related matters. He/she represents the customer and their contractual constraints internally within the shop.Your role:

• Lead and coordinate a team of Shop Visit Managers (engine owners), fostering performance, collaboration, and professional development.
• Oversee the work-in-progress status of all engine projects, ensuring adherence to commitments, schedules, and customer requirements.
• Act as the key interface between Operations, Planning, Supply Chain, Quality, and the customer, ensuring clear communication and accurate reporting on project status and progress.
• Manage customer contractual constraints within the SAESB engine shop.
• Host customer visits, providing visibility on shop performance and ensuring a positive customer experience.*Lead strategic projects aimed at improving engine induction and delivery processes.
• Drive continuous improvement initiatives by analyzing operational performance and customer feedback, with the goal of enhancing volume output and efficiency.

Your profile:
 
 

• You hold a master's degree in engineering with a strong business affinity, or a degree in Business/Economics with a strong technical affinity or equivalent by experience. 

• You have strong business acumen and a results-driven mindset. 

• Experience in the aerospace or aeronautical industry is considered a strong asset. 

• You have at least 3 years of proven people management experience. 

• You are an excellent communicator and are fluent in English. Good knowledge of Dutch and French is a strong asset. 

• You possess strong interpersonal, stakeholder management, and representational skills. 

• You have a strong customer-oriented mindset.  

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Belgium, holding either an EU passport or a valid work & residence permit. Please note that we do not provide assistance with visa or permit applications.

jobs.occupation: Coordinator Internal Sales | Brecht | Vast Contract
jobs.description:
Internal Sales Coördinator 

Are you an experienced people manager who enjoys bringing structure to a fast-paced operational environment? Do you combine strong leadership skills with a hands-on approach to order management, backlog management and customer service?

For an international and dynamic organization, I am looking for an Internal Sales Coördinator to lead a team of four employees.
In this role, you will be close to both the people and the operation. You will coach and develop your team, set priorities, monitor performance and ensure that customers and internal stakeholders receive clear and timely follow-up.

Your responsibilities 

 
• Lead, organize, motivate and coach a team of 4 employees on a daily basis. 
 
• Oversee order and backlog management and ensure customer service enquiries are handled efficiently. 
 
• Set priorities and distribute the workload evenly across the team. 
 
• Monitor team performance, operational metrics and KPIs, and take action where needed. 
 
• Identify training and development needs and provide ongoing coaching. 
 
• Conduct regular one-to-one meetings and performance evaluations. 
 
• Listen to team members' feedback and support them in resolving challenges or conflicts. 
 
• Create sufficient space for team members to contribute to improvement projects alongside their daily responsibilities. 
 
• Work closely with internal stakeholders to resolve escalations and ensure clear communication regarding priorities, progress and expected deliverables. 
 
• Provide management with feedback on operational challenges and identify opportunities for continuous improvement. 
 
• Contribute to a positive and collaborative working environment and organize team-building activities. 

Who are we looking for?
For this position, I am looking for someone who knows how to lead and develop people while maintaining a strong overview of the operational priorities. 

 
• You have several years of experience in a leadership or coordinating position, ideally within sales operations, order management or customer service. 
 
• You have proven people management experience and enjoy coaching, motivating and developing team members. 
 
• You have experience with backlog management and are strong at setting priorities and maintaining overview. 
 
• You are an excellent coordinator and communicator who can effectively manage expectations with different stakeholders. 
 
• You are comfortable monitoring KPIs and using them to drive team performance. 
 
• You have strong organizational, analytical and problem-solving skills. 
 
• You remain calm and effective in a dynamic environment and know how to manage competing priorities. 
 
• You are comfortable working both independently and collaboratively. 
 
• You have solid computer skills, including experience with Microsoft Office, CRM systems and SAP. 
 
• You are fluent in English. Additional languages are an asset, but not a requirement. 
 
• Experience with data modelling and data management tools is considered an advantage. 
 
• You can depend on your own transportation, as the workplace is not accessible by public transport.

Looking for a part-time job where you can work independently and take on real responsibility? 
Do you enjoy working in a refined, stylish setting, and take pride in cleanliness and order?
 

For our two charming hotels in Eeklo — Boutique Hotel Shamon and Aparthotel Acacia — we are looking for a permanent housekeeping team member who helps deliver a flawless and warm guest experience.
 

You'll join a small team where trust, independence, and responsibility are central. You'll be responsible for the overall cleanliness and thorough cleaning of the rooms and the hotel, working independently most of the time. 

 

What will you do?
 
 

• Thoroughly clean and make up the hotel rooms 

• Clean bathrooms and common areas 

• Change bed linen and towels 

• Restock hotel supplies 

• Check cleanliness and quality, including in rooms you didn't clean yourself 

• Maintain hallways, stairs, and shared spaces 

• Occasionally help out with breakfast (clearing tables, light prep) 
 

• You work independently, take responsibility, and have a strong sense of accountability 

• You notice what needs to be done: even during quiet moments, you look around and take initiative 

• You are precise and detail-oriented 

• You are available to work weekends and on Wednesdays 

• Experience in housekeeping or cleaning is a strong plus 

• You speak and understand Dutch and/or English well 

• Good physical condition is required (climbing stairs)

jobs.occupation: Night CE truck driver for live poultry transport
jobs.description:
Job description 

As a vital link in our transport team, you safely collect and deliver poultry while the world sleeps. You will enjoy quiet, traffic-free roads throughout your shift, moving between different locations from Sunday evening to Friday morning. Using your forklift, you handle the loading and unloading of containers with care and precision. This role offers you true independence and responsibility as you manage one to three transport runs each night, ensuring everything is ready for your colleagues when your shift ends.

You will experience the freedom of night driving in a supportive, family-like environment where your contributions are truly valued. Your daily work is diverse, keeping you active and engaged while you take pride in maintaining your truck in top condition. If you appreciate a peaceful workspace without the rush-hour stress, this position is a perfect fit. We look forward to welcoming you to our team, where your professional work ethic makes a real difference in our daily operations.

 Requirements 

    
• Maintain a responsible and professional attitude while driving.
    
• Comfortable working in an environment with industry-related odours.
    
• Experience operating a truck-mounted forklift (kooiaap) is a strong advantage.
    
• Effective communication skills in Dutch, English, or French.

Are you looking for a varied job where you can both apply your technical knowledge and carry out practical tasks?

Then be sure to apply for this operator position!

You will be working in a food company specialized in the processing and storage of a wide range of food products.

As an operator, you are responsible for the smooth running of the production process and ensure that your machines continue to operate efficiently.You do this by:

• Correctly setting machine parameters

• Monitoring quality and making adjustments to the machine when necessary

• Assisting with machine changeovers for new products

• Independently resolving minor technical malfunctions

• Correctly replenishing supplies

• Cleaning the machines

• Consulting with technicians, packaging staff, team leaders, and others

All of this takes place in a refrigerated environment (approximately 8–10°C), working in a three-shift system, while strictly adhering to hygiene and safety regulations.

You have relevant work experience and/or a technical background (e.g. through training or education).

You take pride in keeping your machine running smoothly and in resolving minor breakdowns or blockages quickly and efficiently.

You are flexible and willing to work shifts: early/late and night.

Working in a refrigerated environment (approximately 8–10°C) does not deter you.

You are able to work independently, but you also regularly consult with colleagues to ensure a smooth production process.

You do not mind performing physical work.

You have a good command of Dutch and/or English and are able to commute independently to Dendermonde.

Accountant – The Role:
 

You will report to the Finance Manager and be part of a close-knit accounting team. Your role is varied and involves frequent interaction with colleagues from various departments.
 

Daily accounting: You will process payments from customers and suppliers and reconcile the entries with bank statements.
 

Invoicing and follow-up on outstanding invoices: You prepare sales invoices and send them to
 customers; you follow up on outstanding receivables and take action in the event of
 late payments.
 

Reporting: You collect data for the weekly profitability reports and the monthly KPI reports.
 

Reconciliations: You perform periodic (monthly and annual) reconciliations with customers and suppliers 
 

Invoice verification and collaboration with operations: You review and approve invoices from port, terminal, and administrative suppliers

 Accountant – About You:
 

-
 You have at least a first experience as an in-house accountant, or in an accounting firm
 

-
 You are fluent in Dutch & English
 

-
 You have obtained a degree in Accounting, or in a relevant field
 

-
 An experience in the logistics sector is definitely a plus, but not essential

Are you eager to help manage and optimise our data centre infrastructure? Do you have experience with electricity, HVAC, fire safety, security and/or project management?

• You coordinate initiated projects, monitor and evaluate external parties involved in these projects
• You prepare and manage documentation related to the specifications of technical installations
• You oversee and optimise maintenance activities to ensure the correct operation of technical installations
• You coordinate and carry out technical support tasks related to the existing infrastructure.
• You manage technical procedures and standard solutions within Global Operations, in line with applicable norms, standards, and procedures
• You monitor the progress, budget, quality, risks, and communication of the projects entrusted to you
• You perform in‑depth analyses of electrical, HVAC and security installations
• You participate in an on‑call duty (approximately 10 weeks per year).
What you need to succeed:
• You hold a Master of Science in Industrial Sciences: Electromechanics
• You have at least five years of experience, preferably within a data center environment
• Experience with electricity, HVAC, fire safety, security and/or project management is essential
• Your interests lie in both technical project management and theoretical analysis
• You are eager to learn, have a passion for technology and closely follow developments within your field of expertise
• You have strong communication skills and you are flexible and pragmatic
• You combine an innovative mindset with a strong team spirit
• You work at least two days per week from our datacenter in Hasselt (Universiteitslaan), combined with remote work
• You are fluent in Dutch and English.

What you will do
 

Reporting to the Finance Manager, you join a small, collaborative team. The job is diverse and puts you in regular contact with other departments.
 

Day-to-day bookkeeping: booking incoming and outgoing payments and matching them against bank statements.
 

Billing and credit control: issuing customer invoices, monitoring open receivables and following up 
 on 
 overdue payments.
 

Reporting: gathering figures for regular profitability and performance reporting.
 

Account reconciliations: carrying out monthly and year-end reconciliations of customer and supplier accounts.
 

Supplier invoice control: checking and approving incoming invoices from operational and general suppliers, in close contact with the operations team.

Your profile
 

- 
 First experience in accounting (min. 2 years), either in a company or at an accounting office
 

- 
 Fluent in Dutch and English
 

- 
 Degree in accounting or a related field
 

- 
 Knowledge of the logistics or transport sector is an asset, but not a requirement

jobs.occupation: Production Line Supervisor Slicing | 2-Shift System | Oudenaarde
jobs.description:
Your Challenge

As a Production Line Supervisor, you are the driving force behind a smoothly operating production line. You combine leadership with a hands-on approach and ensure that quality, safety, and efficiency remain top priorities.

What will you do?

• Lead and oversee a modern production line within the High Care department.

• Manage, coach, and motivate a team of approximately 9 employees.

• Foster a positive working atmosphere and encourage strong teamwork.

• Actively participate in the production process while monitoring quality and productivity.

• Identify areas for improvement and contribute ideas for process optimization.

• Troubleshoot and resolve minor technical issues to minimize downtime.

• Ensure a smooth and accurate handover during shift changes.

• Maintain compliance with quality, safety, and hygiene standards.

Who Are We Looking For?

You are someone who enjoys taking responsibility and gets energy from leading people and improving processes.

Your Profile

• You have experience supervising employees in a production environment.

• You possess strong communication and people-management skills.

• You have solid technical knowledge and can independently solve minor technical issues on a production line.

• You are fluent in Dutch and can communicate effectively in English.

• Knowledge of Polish and/or Bulgarian is considered an asset.

• Your educational background is less important than your willingness to learn and grow.

• You are mature, flexible, stress-resistant, and able to work independently.

• You take ownership of your responsibilities and lead by example.
